name: dsh-liaobots-balance-tests
description: Test-only dependencies for the dsh-liaobots-balance browser half. Kept out of the plugin package so the plugin itself stays dependency-free. The plugin itself is NOT a dependency here: that file:.. self-link turned the test directory into a junction back to the workspace root, so anything walking the installed (link:) package with symlinks followed could recurse forever. Tests reach the plugin by relative path, and test/package.test.mjs by the package's own exports self-reference.
